contract: Use Reader with the access-unit contract’s audio and subtitle tail reporting and explicit ADTS and LATM policies. Read its track views through TrackInfo.

Read the complete mpegts-access-units corpus through the selected program, advancing ordered entities and flushing at a declared discontinuity. The reference uses the public parser-enabled MPEG-TS demuxer with NOFILLIN, without stream discovery.

The packet record compares stream index, PID, demux PTS and DTS, duration, position, flags, payload length and bytes, and time base. A following record compares each side-data element in order. Clean end requires consuming the last physical entity.

Compare the media kind, codec identity, published codec tag, configuration epoch and codec configuration bytes for each track. The reference observes AVProgram.pmt_version and AVStream.codecpar, giving the first visible PMT epoch number 2. The source route controls use the source counter instead, deriving its epochs independently from CRC-valid PAT and PMT transitions and declared entity boundaries at the reference packet positions. The candidate projects registered tags and the DVB composition page, ancillary page and subtitling type from the PMT descriptor.

Compare the track's program number, PCR PID, stream type and program and elementary descriptors against the original PMT carrier ranges. Check that reported opaque and incomplete elementary ranges recover exactly the published bytes from the original PES payload.

Compare the AC-3 and E-AC-3 syncframe lengths with the public AC-3 parser applied to the reference packet. An incomplete AC-3 flush carries the available and declared byte extents in a separate row. For DVB subtitles, count EN 300 743 §7.2 segments and the unfinished tail on the original PES that starts at the reference packet's carrier, as the reader reports them. For opaque video and private audio, compare the reported elementary range against the reference packet payload extent and compare private audio carriage from the codec and transport tag.
A library refusal ends the candidate's fold with one kind 8 record; a failed check of the worker's own ends the worker with an error, which no registry entry admits.

open_deviations.reading: A legal duplicate transport packet carries no new payload
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 permits one consecutive copy of a payload-carrying packet on a PID, byte-identical apart from a valid PCR, as a duplicate of the first; the M2TS prefix lies outside the packet.
open_deviations.candidate: Publishes the original opaque run once, with its own clock and source range.
open_deviations.reference: Includes the duplicate's bytes in the opaque packet and can merge them with the original run.
open_deviations.compat: compat::annex_b::ContinuityReader reports the run the reference demuxes as one packet (its ts-reader-container case passes)

open_deviations.reading: An elementary run does not continue across a signalled change of time base
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.5: discontinuity_indicator on the PCR PID announces a new system time base, which begins with the next PCR; a presentation time stamp coded before the discontinuity belongs to the old time base and does not apply to bytes after it.
open_deviations.candidate: Publishes the opaque run before the discontinuity (27 bytes at PTS 90000) and the run after it (3 bytes at PTS 10) separately, each in its own clock epoch.
open_deviations.reference: Joins both runs into one 30-byte opaque packet at PTS 90000.
open_deviations.compat: compat::annex_b::ContinuityReader reports the run the reference demuxes as one packet (its ts-reader-container case passes)

open_deviations.reading: A scrambled transport payload is not a clear PES
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 and Table 2-4: transport_scrambling_control 10 scrambles the whole packet payload, the PES header included.
open_deviations.candidate: Publishes no opaque packet from the scrambled carrier; Reader reports the scrambling as a source diagnostic.
open_deviations.reference: Parses the scrambled payload as a clear PES and publishes its 27 bytes at PTS 90000.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts transport-scrambled passes) at the PES level

open_policies.policy: An excess copy of a transport packet inside an unframed run
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 allows at most two consecutive packets with one continuity_counter value; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the excess copy ends the run: the complete PES before it are published as one opaque run, the PES it interrupts is discarded, and a later clean unit starts the next run.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: merges the copies and a later clean unit into one opaque packet.
open_policies.compat: compat::annex_b::ContinuityReader reports the run the reference demuxes as one packet (its ts-reader-container case passes)

open_policies.policy: An unframed run interrupted by a continuity-counter gap
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 defines continuity_counter per PID, so a gap means lost packets; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the gap ends the run: the complete PES before it are published as one opaque run, the PES it interrupts is discarded, and the next admitted run is published by itself.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: returns the bytes across the gap as one opaque packet with the first run's clock and position.
open_policies.compat: compat::annex_b::ContinuityReader reports the run the reference demuxes as one packet (its ts-reader-container case passes)

open_policies.policy: A carrier that repeats a continuity counter with other bytes inside an unframed run
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 lets a packet repeat the continuity_counter only as a duplicate, byte-identical apart from a valid PCR; changed payload or a changed OPCR under the repeated counter is not one; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the carrier is a continuity fault that ends the run: the complete PES before it is published as one opaque run, and the PES the faulted carrier starts opens the next run.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: joins both payloads into one opaque packet with the first run's clock and position.
open_policies.compat: compat::annex_b::ContinuityReader reports the run the reference demuxes as one packet (its ts-reader-container case passes)

open_policies.policy: An opaque PES in a carrier whose PCR extension is out of range
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.5 codes program_clock_reference_extension modulo 300; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the carrier with an invalid PCR is rejected with its payload and no opaque packet is published.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes the 27 bytes at PTS 90000.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pcr-extension-invalid passes) at the PES level; no option reproduces the parsed packet

open_policies.policy: An opaque PES in a carrier with the transport error indicator set
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 defines transport_error_indicator as at least one uncorrectable bit error; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the errored carrier's payload is discarded and no opaque packet is published.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes the 27 bytes at PTS 90000.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts transport-tei passes) at the PES level; no option reproduces the parsed packet

open_policies.policy: An opaque PES whose header has a zero timestamp marker bit
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 Table 2-21 requires each PTS marker_bit to be 1; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the malformed PES is rejected and no opaque packet is published.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes the 27 bytes at PTS 90000.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pes-timestamp-marker passes) at the PES level; no option reproduces the parsed packet

open_policies.policy: An opaque PES whose header has PTS_DTS_flags 01
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 forbids PTS_DTS_flags value 01; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the malformed PES is rejected and no opaque packet is published.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes the 27 bytes with neither clock.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pes-forbidden-time-flags passes) at the PES level; no option reproduces the parsed packet

open_policies.policy: An opaque PES across a carrier that codes OPCR without PCR
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.5 allows OPCR only in a packet that carries PCR; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the carrier with the unpaired OPCR is rejected and no opaque packet is published.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: combines both payloads into 54 opaque bytes.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts opcr-without-pcr-invalid passes) at the PES level; no option reproduces the parsed packet

open_policies.policy: An opaque finite PES that ends before its declared length
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 PES_packet_length declares more bytes than the input holds; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the incomplete PES is not published.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes the 24 available bytes.
open_policies.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pes-finite-truncated-eof passes) at the PES level; no option reproduces the parsed packet

open_policies.policy: Payload past the declared length of an opaque finite PES
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §§2.4.3.3 and 2.4.3.7: PES_packet_length gives the extent of the PES packet, and a carrier without payload_unit_start_indicator continues it past that extent; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the PES is delivered with the 400 bytes its PES_packet_length declares and the bytes past them are reported as a Pes fault and dropped; Reader publishes the 400 bytes as an opaque run before that fault.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes every carried byte, 401 to 415, as one opaque packet.
open_policies.compat: compat::opaque_video::OpaqueRecovery replays the entity and reports the run with the bytes past the declared length, as the reference does (the mpegts-access-units cases of these inputs pass)

open_policies.policy: A PAT version announced over two sections of which one arrives
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.4.6 applies version_number to the whole PAT and last_section_number gives its extent; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): Reader waits for every section of a version before routing its programs, so no program comes from the partial PAT.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: routes the program from the first section although the second never arrives.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat option exists for a consumer; the comparison-only reference_trace::catalogue compatible profile reproduces the reference (the -compat cases of ts-catalogue pass)

open_policies.policy: A PMT descriptor that runs past its loop
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §§2.4.4.10 and 2.6.1: ES_info_length 6 encloses an ISO 639 descriptor of length 8; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): Reader rejects the malformed PMT and exposes no stream from it.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes the stream entry from the malformed PMT.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat option exists for a consumer; the comparison-only reference_trace::catalogue compatible profile reproduces the reference (the -compat cases of ts-catalogue pass)

open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.4.10 requires section_number and last_section_number 0 in a PMT; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): Reader rejects the PMT and exposes no stream from it.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: publishes the stream from the PMT.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat option exists for a consumer; the comparison-only reference_trace::catalogue compatible profile reproduces the reference (the -compat cases of ts-catalogue pass)

open_policies.policy: Stream types 0x81 and 0x87 without a declared descriptor namespace
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.4.10 Table 2-34 leaves stream type 0x06 to private data and 0x80 to 0xFF to user-private use, and §2.6.1 Table 2-45 leaves descriptor tags 64 to 255 user-private; the AC-3 meaning comes from the system (ETSI EN 300 468 Annex D, ATSC A/52 Annex A) the input does not declare; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Opt-in policies): with DescriptorNamespace::Unspecified, the default, Reader keeps the private stream type and leaves the codec unknown.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: assumes ATSC and identifies AC-3 and E-AC-3.
open_policies.compat: none: ReaderLimits::descriptor_namespace = Dvb or Atsc identifies the codec as the reference does (the declared-namespace cases of the same carriage pass)

open_policies.policy: DVB AC-3 and E-AC-3 descriptors without a declared descriptor namespace
open_policies.undecided: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.4.10 Table 2-34 leaves stream type 0x06 to private data and 0x80 to 0xFF to user-private use, and §2.6.1 Table 2-45 leaves descriptor tags 64 to 255 user-private; the AC-3 meaning comes from the system (ETSI EN 300 468 Annex D, ATSC A/52 Annex A) the input does not declare; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_policies.rule: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Opt-in policies): with DescriptorNamespace::Unspecified, the default, Reader does not read the private descriptors and leaves the codec unknown.
open_policies.reference_rule: Observed rule: assumes DVB and identifies AC-3 and E-AC-3 from the descriptors.
open_policies.compat: none: ReaderLimits::descriptor_namespace = Dvb or Atsc identifies the codec as the reference does (the declared-namespace cases of the same carriage pass)
